# yyyymm

The goal of `yyyymm::` is to make life easier with period format.

## Installation

``` r

source("https://install-github.me/jbkunst/yyyymm")
```

## Some Examples

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(yyyymm)
ym_to_date(ym = c(200902, 201912), day = 1)
#> [1] "2009-02-01" "2019-12-01"
```

Get month differences:

``` r

ym_diff(ym = c(200902, 201912), ym2 = c(200901, 201712))
#> [1]  1 24


ym_add_months(c(200902, 201912), months = c(1, -12))
#> [1] 200903 201812
```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`date_format_jy()`](https://jkunst.com/yyyymm/reference/date_format_jy.md)
  : A date format helper to show the year in January
- [`date_to_ym()`](https://jkunst.com/yyyymm/reference/date_to_ym.md) :
  Date to period string
- [`scale_x_date_year()`](https://jkunst.com/yyyymm/reference/scale_x_date_year.md)
  [`scale_x_date_yyyymm()`](https://jkunst.com/yyyymm/reference/scale_x_date_year.md)
  : Auxiliar shortcut scales with opinionated pre-sets
- [`ym_add_months()`](https://jkunst.com/yyyymm/reference/ym_add_months.md)
  : Add months to a year month
- [`ym_diff()`](https://jkunst.com/yyyymm/reference/ym_diff.md) : Year
  month string to date
- [`ym_div()`](https://jkunst.com/yyyymm/reference/ym_div.md) : Year
  month to semester, quarter, trimester
- [`ym_format()`](https://jkunst.com/yyyymm/reference/ym_format.md) :
  Format a year month into a specific date format A wrapper for
  ym_to_date and format:
- [`ym_seq()`](https://jkunst.com/yyyymm/reference/ym_seq.md) : Sequence
  of months
- [`ym_to_date()`](https://jkunst.com/yyyymm/reference/ym_to_date.md) :
  Year month string to date
